content:
From: Makarius <makarius@sketis.net>

Dear Isabelle users,

approx. 10 days before Isabelle2026 will become final and unchangeable, we
have another release candidate: Isabelle2026-RC4. See also
https://sketis.net/2026/release-candidates-for-isabelle2026 for details.
Everything is finished from my side, which means the release windows is about
to close very soon.

The main Isabelle website is
https://isabelle.in.tum.de/website-Isabelle2026-RC4 and regular AFP is
https://foss.heptapod.net/isa-afp/afp-2026

Any feedback about Isabelle release candidates should be posted with a
meaningful Mail subject, not just a clone of this announcement.

Makarius

From: Makarius <makarius@sketis.net>

On 14/10/2026 17:27, Makarius wrote:

The main Isabelle website is https://isabelle.in.tum.de/website-Isabelle2026-
RC4 and regular AFP is https://foss.heptapod.net/isa-afp/afp-2026

Any feedback about Isabelle release candidates should be posted with a
meaningful Mail subject, not just a clone of this announcement.
There is been no further activity on this thread, so I am assuming that
everything is fine, according to the social contract behind Isabelle releases
(since 2008):

* The overall quality of the system becomes gradually better.
* Serious regressions that were recently introduced have been addressed.

Consequently, I will produce the final and unchangeable Isabelle2026 release
in approx. 12h, but it will take 1-2 days afterwards to get everything
synchronized and published.

Unless, someone presents new problems that justify to postpone the final
release, e.g. for 1 week.

Reminder: Isabelle has a linear release model, without "hotfixes" nor
"patches". Instead there will be eventually another regular release, at a
distance of 8-10 months.

Makarius
